processes.name: Pipeline capacity reporting and release
processes.definition: Reporting pipeline deliveries and available capacity to customers and colleagues, and handling capacity release to shippers.
include: Weekly capacity reports for California deliveries
Available firm capacity postings
Capacity release notices
exclude: Negotiating operational balancing agreements: oba-contract-negotiation
example_subjects: california capacity report for week of 10/22-10/26
california capacity report for week of 12/17-12/21

processes.name: Commercial strategy planning
processes.definition: Planning commercial strategy and the yearly plan for a pipeline team, including strategy meetings on projects and customers.
include: Plan and strategy meeting arrangements
Project strategy discussions with a customer
exclude: Staff performance reviews: performance-review

processes.name: Credit report distribution
processes.definition: Preparing and sending the dated credit report on counterparty exposure to the people who rely on it.
include: Credit reports dated by day
Questions or corrections on a credit report
exclude: Profit and loss or mark-to-market reports: pnl-reporting

processes.name: Price curve and post ID maintenance
processes.definition: Maintaining price curve mappings and the lists of post IDs used to value positions, and circulating updated lists.
include: Curve mapping files and their status
Lists of post IDs for a month or region
exclude: The P&L results themselves: pnl-reporting

processes.name: Customer volume confirmation
processes.definition: Confirming monthly and daily delivered volumes with end-use and utility customers, and agreeing the volumes used for billing.
include: Monthly volume or flow figures for a utility or industrial customer
Scheduled volumes sent to a customer
exclude: Unexplained flow at a single meter: meter-flow-resolution
Nominations received: gas-nomination

processes.name: Deal transfer between books
processes.definition: Identifying deals to move, kill or terminate and moving them to another book, such as the bankruptcy books, and reconciling the lists of deals moved.
include: Lists of deals to be moved, flipped or zeroed out
Termination lists for the bankruptcy book
exclude: Creating a new book: trading-book-setup
New deal tickets at a meter: deal-ticket-setup
example_subjects: deals to be flipped to ft-us/cand-erms book right away
termination list for deals to be moved to bankruptcy book
deals to be moved to bankruptcy books (from russell's exposure report)
killing ena to ena deals in sitara

processes.name: Deal ticket and transport contract set-up
processes.definition: Creating, extending or replacing deal tickets and transport contracts in Sitara so that gas at a meter or on a pipeline has a valid deal for the month.
include: Requests for a new deal or contract needed at a meter
Notice that a deal ticket was created or extended
Expired deals needing a replacement
exclude: Moving existing deals between trading books: deal-book-transfer
Unexplained flow at a meter: meter-flow-resolution
example_subjects: ena 202 and hpl 216 transport contracts needed at meter 378 for march 2000
copano line gain contract needed at meter 5310

processes.name: Expense report approval
processes.definition: Submitting and approving employee expense reports and their status changes in the expense system.
include: Expense reports ready for approval
Status changes on an expense document
exclude: Month-end accruals: month-end-close

processes.name: Gas nomination and nomination changes
processes.definition: Receiving, entering and confirming daily and monthly gas nominations from customers and suppliers, and processing revisions when a party changes its requested volumes.
include: Daily or monthly nominations sent by a counterparty such as Calpine
Revised nominations or nom changes with an effective date
Confirmation that a nomination was entered or scheduled
exclude: Questions about volumes that actually flowed at a meter: meter-flow-resolution
Supply cuts announced by a pipeline: supply-cut-handling
example_subjects: nom change for increased midcon gas

processes.name: Pipeline imbalance resolution
processes.definition: Reconciling gas imbalances with pipelines and counterparties, exchanging volume statements and agreeing how the imbalance is cleared.
include: Imbalance updates and statements
Requests for daily volume statements to check an imbalance
exclude: Payment of invoices or penalties: settlement-resolution

processes.name: Meter flow discrepancy resolution
processes.definition: Investigating gas that flowed at a meter without a matching deal or with unexpected volumes, deciding how the flow is booked, and clearing the unaccounted volume.
include: Messages citing a meter number with flow, spill-over or production for a past date
Questions on whom unbooked or small volumes belong to
Production month volumes at a wellhead or plant meter
exclude: Creating or extending the deal ticket itself: deal-ticket-setup
Volume confirmations with an end customer: customer-volume-confirmation

processes.name: Month-end close and schedules
processes.definition: Running the accounting month-end close: agreeing the close schedule, releasing and revising closing schedules, and confirming items are complete.
include: Close schedules and revisions to them
Messages releasing a closing schedule
Requests to submit items to be expensed before close
exclude: Employee expense reports: expense-approval

processes.name: Transport contract and OBA negotiation
processes.definition: Negotiating, drafting and approving transportation contracts and operational balancing agreements with shippers and interconnecting pipelines.
include: Proposed contract language or paragraph changes
Approval status of an OBA or contract
Contract numbers raised with a pipeline
exclude: Settling an imbalance under an existing agreement: imbalance-resolution
example_subjects: blue dolphin pipe line company contract no. 96037499

processes.name: On-call and holiday coverage
processes.definition: Arranging weekend, holiday and after-hours coverage and handing over on-call notes on what happened during the shift.
include: On-call notes for a weekend
Staffing plans for holidays
After-hours contact details
exclude: Personal out-of-office replies
example_subjects: on call notes for weekend; april 7th thru april 9th

processes.name: Performance review
processes.definition: Running staff performance reviews: scheduling PRC meetings and collecting accomplishments and feedback.
include: PRC meeting scheduling
Requests for year-end accomplishments
exclude: Commercial planning meetings: commercial-strategy-planning

processes.name: Pipeline maintenance coordination
processes.definition: Coordinating planned pipeline and meter maintenance, such as pigging, with producers and customers whose meters are affected.
include: Maintenance dates at a meter
Letters to producers about affected meters
exclude: Unplanned supply cuts: supply-cut-handling

processes.name: P&L and mark-to-market reporting
processes.definition: Producing, reviewing and explaining desk profit and loss and mark-to-market results for traders and management.
include: Daily or month-end P&L and MTM files
Desk summary reports
Explanations of P&L changes
exclude: Curve or post ID maintenance behind the numbers: curve-postid-maintenance
Credit exposure reports: credit-reporting

processes.name: Real-time power scheduling
processes.definition: Scheduling and correcting real-time power trades, imports and positions with the CAISO and counterparties, and staffing the real-time schedule.
include: Corrections to import or tie-point schedules
Short or long positions for the next day
Inter-SC trades and real-time shift schedules
Transmission derates affecting schedules
exclude: Disputes over payments or prices: settlement-resolution
CAISO rule and market design notices: regulatory-notice-review
example_subjects: new real time schedule for december 2001

processes.name: Regulatory and market notice review
processes.definition: Reviewing and circulating regulator and ISO notices on market rules, and taking part in the related calls and comment work.
include: CAISO market notices and proposals
FERC rulemaking notices
Stakeholder conference calls
exclude: Day-to-day schedule changes: real-time-power-scheduling
example_subjects: caiso notice: market design 2002 draft proposal
ferc issues nopr on intra-day recalls of released capacity

processes.name: Settlement and invoice resolution
processes.definition: Resolving invoices, payments, penalty charges and price disputes with counterparties for gas and power deals.
include: Questions on whether an invoice is owed
Payment checks and congestion revenue
Penalty charges and exchange settlements
Corrected deal prices for settlement
exclude: Volume imbalances with a pipeline: imbalance-resolution

processes.name: Gas supply cut handling
processes.definition: Responding when a pipeline or supplier cuts scheduled gas: finding the affected deals, rescheduling supply and informing customers.
include: Notices of cuts on a pipeline for specific days
Rescheduling after a cut
exclude: Power schedule curtailments and derates: real-time-power-scheduling
Planned pipeline maintenance: pipeline-maintenance-notice

processes.name: System access requests
processes.definition: Requesting, granting and removing user access and roles in trading and operations systems.
include: Access request submissions and follow-up information
Setting up or disabling user accounts
Confirming traders are set up to trade
exclude: Errors in a working system: system-issue-resolution

processes.name: System issue resolution
processes.definition: Reporting and fixing errors and changes in operations and trading systems, such as bridge errors, EOL issues and Sitara releases.
include: Error messages from a system
Deals failing to bridge
System release changes and their effect
exclude: Access and user set-up: system-access-request
example_subjects: sitara release (re: changes in global due to consent to assignment)

processes.name: Time reports and activity surveys
processes.definition: Collecting time reports and hours or activity surveys from staff by their due date.
include: Reminders that time reports are due
Hours and activity survey requests and replies
exclude: Expense reports: expense-approval

processes.name: Trading book set-up requests
processes.definition: Requesting, approving and creating new trading books in the risk systems, and confirming the books are ready for deals.
include: Book requests and new book forms
Confirmation that new books exist
exclude: Moving deals into an existing book: deal-book-transfer
